name: Isometric 3D diorama / infographic
look: miniature isometric world, flat 3-tone blocks, rail-style camera, labels in thin ink.

fits.notes: infra, logistics, finance flow, platforms, "how it works"

type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: DM Mono, Inter; 3-tone per colour (top/left/right), pastel + one accent.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: 3 tones of the brand colour on the hero structure; pastels elsewhere
brand_lock.type_role: mono or neutral sans for labels in thin ink; brand face for the claim
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

hints: buildings grow, belts move, pipes fill, camera tracks along an isometric axis
pieces pop in on a beat
motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: isometric {subject} building / prop sprite sheet on a flat pure chroma-green (#00FF00) background, equal grid cells, no text, 3-tone shading, one consistent light direction
codex_assets.r1_note: isometric building/prop sprites on flat bg (A1); keep one consistent light direction.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: `runtime/medium-isometric.js`, `styles/isometric.md`, `iso-infographic.md`, `motion/other/isometric-motion.md`. SVG polygons or Three.js ortho at 35.264/45 degrees.

examples.title: Monument Valley ; Stripe Sessions isometric illustration

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Blueprint candy
palettes.words: pale sky white, navy ink, orange, teal

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour paints the one hero building or package; the platform, other blocks and ink stay style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Mono labels with thin leader lines attached to objects.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: true isometric 30 degree grid (2:1 dimetric ok); platform tile centred; objects snap to tiles
composition.safe_area: 10% margin; platform fills the middle 60%; callouts in outer thirds
composition.product_ui: UI lives on a flat monitor tile or a floating panel parallel to an isometric plane

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: orthographic isometric, 35.264 degrees elevation, 45 degrees azimuth, no perspective. Lighting: soft key upper left, ambient fill, soft AO under objects, long soft shadow to lower right. Material: matte plastic-like blocks with a 1 px lighter top edge, flat colour. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: flat colour per face with 3 tones; almost no noise. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no perspective convergence, no photoreal materials, no cluttered micro detail, no text in the image, no tilted verticals.
codex.camera: orthographic isometric, 35.264 degrees elevation, 45 degrees azimuth, no perspective
codex.lighting: soft key upper left, ambient fill, soft AO under objects, long soft shadow to lower right
codex.material: matte plastic-like blocks with a 1 px lighter top edge, flat colour
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: flat colour per face with 3 tones; almost no noise

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: matte plastic-like blocks with a 1 px lighter top edge; orthographic isometric; pale sky white, navy ink, orange, teal.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Stay on one iso angle everywhere
Draw systems: paths, conveyors, flows between nodes
Use labelled leader lines (live type) for callouts
dont: No dense decoration that hides the flow
cheap_ways: Generic stack of server boxes with no flow
Random isometric icons floating without a ground
